speaker: Doctor
text: Can you describe the specific sensations you experience during these episodes, and do they last for seconds, minutes, or hours? REQUEST TEST: Hearing_Assessment.

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Audiometry: Bilateral high-frequency sensorineural hearing loss, consistent with presbycusis. No sudden drops in hearing indicative of Meniere's disease or labyrinthitis.

speaker: Doctor
text: Do you experience any ringing in your ears or a feeling of fullness in your ear during these dizzy spells? REQUEST TEST: Vestibular_Swings; REQUEST IMAGES: MRI_Impairment.

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Vestibular_Swings: Normal vestibular response with the exception of response elicited during Dix-Hallpike maneuver, consistent with BPPV. MRI_Impairment: No evidence of central lesions or infarcts that would suggest central causes of vertigo.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Benign Paroxysmal Positional Vertigo (BPPV). The normal vestibular function combined with positive Dix-Hallpike findings and the absence of central lesions or Meniere's symptoms confirms this diagnosis. I will now discuss the canalith repositioning maneuver to treat your condition.
